title: Debiasing Vision-Language Models via Biased Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy gaps on the CelebA dataset, measuring the MaxSkew metric for zero-shot text-image retrieval on the FairFace dataset, and calculating statistical discrepancy (L2 norm from a uniform distribution) in images generated from profession prompts using automated classifiers and human evaluation.

Measuring the MaxSkew metric for text-image retrieval fairness on the FairFace dataset, and computing the statistical discrepancy of racial distributions in images generated by text-to-image models using automated classifiers and human annotators.
Measuring the MaxSkew metric for zero-shot text-image retrieval on the FairFace dataset to assess how evenly the retrieved images are distributed across age groups.

Evaluating group robustness by calculating the gap between average and worst-group classification accuracy on the Waterbird dataset (where background is spuriously correlated with the bird type), and visually assessing generated images for background diversity.
